fields.name: bias_types
fields.definition: Categories of social or representation bias explicitly discussed in relation to LLMs or generative AI, encompassing observed findings and potential risks. Fairness indicators, sources of bias and mitigation strategies fall outside this field.

fields.name: software_engineering_tasks_or_contexts
fields.definition: Software engineering activities and professional or educational contexts in which bias or fairness in LLMs or generative AI is explicitly investigated or discussed. Activities may be performed using these systems or represented in their generated content. The extraction target is the specific activity or context, whether evaluated or proposed. Profession names and assigned roles alone do not establish the performance or representation of a technical activity. Evaluation of an activity does not imply that bias was found. Internal pipeline construction, configuration, orchestration and infrastructure fall outside this scope when their only role is supporting the system.

fields.name: llm_systems
fields.definition: Identifiable LLMs, assistants or generative systems actually evaluated as subjects of the study's bias analysis. Mention of a generic model category, proposed architecture component, training technique or auxiliary tool alone does not establish its role as an evaluated subject.

fields.name: bias_sources
fields.definition: Factors explicitly asserted or hypothesized by the authors to originate, reintroduce or amplify bias. The scope encompasses broad factors as well as specific mechanisms, at the level of detail provided in the article. Empirical confirmation is not a prerequisite for a factor explicitly identified as a possible source.

fields.name: evaluation_methods
fields.definition: Methods, datasets or indicators explicitly proposed or used to detect or evaluate bias or fairness. General performance, security or efficiency measures fall within this field only when the article establishes their role in bias evaluation.

fields.name: reported_impacts
fields.definition: Consequences explicitly attributed by the authors to bias in LLMs, other generative AI systems, or applications using these systems. The scope encompasses potential harms, background claims and observed consequences for people, groups, activities or the use of these systems. An article-supported connection to generative AI is required; examples concerning other AI systems alone fall outside this field. Biased output patterns or group disparities themselves are manifestations and do not by themselves establish downstream harms. Sources of bias, detection metrics and unrelated security or explainability concerns fall outside this field.

fields.name: manifestations
fields.definition: Concrete ways bias appears in LLM or generative-AI outputs or behavior, such as stereotyped content, demographic skew, differential recommendations and performance disparities between groups. The scope encompasses observed patterns and explicitly discussed potential patterns. Bias category names alone, causes, downstream consequences and metric names alone are not manifestations. The existence of a proposed metric or mitigation strategy does not by itself establish a manifestation.

fields.name: mitigation_strategies
fields.definition: Interventions proposed, implemented or evaluated to reduce or prevent bias. The scope encompasses individual interventions and umbrella strategies with their explicitly named examples. General security, efficiency or alignment mechanisms fall within this field only when the article establishes their connection to bias mitigation.
